title: Personal Training Packages: deciding the amount charged for a trainer reassignment
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the free-use allowance and the corporate wellness discount together decide the amount charged for a specific trainer reassignment.

## Rule
Where the reassignment being logged still falls within the package's own free-use allowance, the amount charged is zero, regardless of any corporate wellness enrollment the member may hold. Where the reassignment falls beyond that allowance, the amount charged is the tier's own flat reassignment fee after any corporate wellness reduction, rounded to 2 decimal places.

## Points of judgement
The free-use check is decided first: a reassignment within the allowance is always free, and the corporate wellness reduction is never consulted for it. Only once a reassignment falls beyond the allowance does the corporate wellness reduction apply to decide the actual amount charged for that reassignment.
